facts.business: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is a public sector steel manufacturing company producing steel products for domestic infrastructure, automotive, and construction sectors.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex for environmental and social impact
R&D expenditure for environmental and social impact

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (a) Revenue from sales to government agencies recognized on provisional prices (₹2,479.36 crore for quarter, ₹9,723.71 crore for year ended 31st March 2026, cumulative ₹18,766.51 crore). (b) Exceptional items: ₹451.34 crore increase in Gratuity Liability and ₹216.88 crore net impact of DVC electricity tariff dispute adjustment. (c) Suspension of certain officers/employees per Ministry of Steel directions and related investigation on policy/pricing decisions; management assesses no material impact.

key_risks: Commodity supply risk for imported hard coking coal due to limited vendors and geographic concentration; action being taken to increase vendor base and explore new geographies (Russia, Mozambique).

Non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations on Board composition (Independent Directors, Woman Director), Audit Committee, and Nomination & Remuneration Committee during FY 2025-26, resulting in fines from BSE and NSE totaling ₹1,24,18,320 over three years.

Contingent liabilities: Claims against Group pending appellate/judicial decisions ₹35,378.29 crore; other claims not acknowledged as debt ₹7,911.53 crore; disputed tax demands on JVs ₹40.81 crore (as at 31st March 2026).
Suspension of officers/employees and investigation by external agencies on policy/pricing decisions per Ministry of Steel directions.
